method: Provisional engineering estimates of functional checklist completion; ranges are not statistical confidence intervals or time estimates.
rules: 100% requires the declared source scope inventoried, migrated, integrated and verified.
Offline data acceptance does not imply live gameplay or visual acceptance.
Do not sum or average overlapping area estimates into a whole-game percentage.
Record changes to scope and denominators before revising estimates.
Report completed range, remaining range, change and remaining acceptance criteria at each progress update.
Animation 1:1 verification remains deferred by user request; lighting remains last priority.
